about: Every variant replayed at this target that is not handled, with the probes that failed. A run must match exactly (replay/README.md, Expectations).

backfill.p22-refunds-in-tx-changes-after.why: F-3. Before protocol 23 a Soroban fee refund is credited in txChangesAfter; wallet-backend's native balances read fee changes, operation changes and post-apply refunds (protocol 23+) only, so the 7 refunded accounts of pubnet ledger 56085459 end short by exactly their refund, while its own BALANCE history rows add up to the ledger.
